Question: Assalamwaalikum is it allow in islam a muslim lady can take a bath in standing position in side the hammam? as per Quran & Hadith. shukaran! Answer ID: 10930 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 233/233=M/1430) Yes, she can do, but it is better to bath sitting.
